title: Frappe Framework before 15.123.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the……
description: Frappe Framework versions before 15.123.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contain a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in the frappe.email.email_body.get_email_html method. This method lacks proper role checks, allowing authenticated users, including portal Website Users, to inject stylesheet link tags into unescaped email templates. This injection causes the Premailer component to fetch content from internal or external hosts and return it, potentially exposing internal resources.
